summary: Iter57 — Verified (1) /taxi-bidding find-driver-btn bug fix (now always enabled once submitting=false, with fallback fare estimate→liveStats→10 EUR) and (2) /ride V3Cube redesign (Step1 blue header, Step2 Location Taxi floating btn, blue CTA, FR vehicle descriptions, blue price/selection). All acceptance criteria met. Backend 5/5 pytest passing, frontend end-to-end verified on live preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: RideBookingPage.js is 834 lines — approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider splitting Step1/Step2/Negotiation/Searching into sub-components for maintainability.

Google Maps JS API loaded multiple times (console warning). Likely because useJsApiLoader is invoked in several components without a shared loader ID. Non-blocking but wastes quota; consider configuring a single `LoadScript` at the app root or using same `id` in useJsApiLoader across all consumers.

getEstimateForAddress in RideBookingPage.js fakes dropoff coords with Math.random() offsets around Paris when a recent location is clicked — this produces an inaccurate estimated fare/route for recent-location flow. Should resolve real coords via Google Geocoding before calling /api/rides/estimate.

handleSubmit fallback in TaxiBiddingPage.js: `finalFare = estimate?.estimated_fare || liveStats?.avg_accepted_fare || 10` — 10 EUR default may be below backend min_fare for some vehicle types (e.g. luxe min 25 EUR). Recommend reading min_fare from /api/config/vehicle-types as last fallback.

rca of the issue: User-reported bug 'find-driver-btn ne fonctionne pas' was due to `disabled={submitting || fare <= 0}` on the button. In some flows the fare input could reach 0 (user edits) or the estimate never loaded. Fix confirmed in TaxiBiddingPage.js line 306: `disabled={submitting}` only; and handleSubmit falls back to estimate.estimated_fare || liveStats.avg_accepted_fare || 10 EUR when fare<=0 on submit. Verified live: find-btn stays clickable with fare=0 and POSTs /api/rides successfully, navigating to /ride/{id}.
